body: VOLUNTEER FOR bd-01M171DBN80HMVAKNKEK30GRP9 while D2 waits on Slice E. Read-only source trace sharpens the mechanism without overclaiming: public nested namespaces E/S/C/G initialize their ids by calling private eid/sid/cid/gid methods on the enclosing WarOfTheGhostsModel. Expectations forces E/S first and later G; that call into the enclosing singleton explains why outer model construction can observe the namespace half-initialized. Narrow fix can preserve the public WarOfTheGhostsModel.E/S/C/G namespaces exactly: move only the four private ID constructors to a package-private top-level helper, have the existing nested objects call that helper, and remove their dependency on the enclosing singleton. No new public vocabulary and no literal-id duplication. Exact proposed paths: fixtures/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/fixtures/wog/WarOfTheGhostsModel.scala plus a new JVM initialization-order probe suite (and Expectations.scala only if the trace proves necessary; current design should not require it). Failure shield must not depend on ordinary suite order: run the expectations-first probe in a fresh classloader/process, show it fails pre-fix with the fabricated null diagnostics, then passes post-fix; mutation one namespace back to the enclosing helper must make it fail again. Full fixtures reference scope remains all three platforms. No paths are currently reserved at the two source files; I hold none. Chief: assign this existing bead if you want it before D2, otherwise I remain queued for D2.
